free_tier.stated: 'There's no additional charge for enabling code execution from the Gemini API.' The generated code, its results and the summary are billed as input and output tokens at the rate of the Gemini model used; https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/code-execution (read 2026-10-30) states no amount or period of free use
free_tier.notes: The token allowance is the Gemini API free tier of the model used: the pricing page says 'Start building free of charge with generous limits' and lists input and output as 'Free of charge' on the Free Tier of the models that have one; Gemini 4 Argon is not available on the Free tier. The per-model free-tier volume is unverified.

interface_detail: REST API (POST to generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions with the code_execution tool) and the Google GenAI SDK, both documented on the code execution page.
tooling: Google GenAI SDK (Python package google-genai, JavaScript package @google/genai, Go and Java); the REST API directly.

limits.value: the maximum input file size is bounded by the model's token window, not by a code-execution quota

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. Exceeds capacity threshold.

identity_cost.detail: email: a Google account, because the API key page redirects to Google's sign-in, which asks for a Google Account, and AI Studio then creates the project and the key. No card is required for the free tier: linking a billing account is what moving to the paid tier means. No phone is named, and access is limited to the countries and territories Google lists.
